messages:
sam_support: incoming ticket from FinCorp — they need streaming responses that can emit function/tool calls mid-stream and also end with a validated structured JSON payload. they want tool argument tokens streamed as they're generated so their downstream toolchain can start work asap. ticket: https://zendesk/12345

Aisha_pm: tagging product for triage. is this something we can absorb into existing streaming toolcall work, or does it need a separate opt-in/flag?

marta_eng: quick gut — our streaming already supports text frames, but emitting structured toolcall events will need protocol framing changes + runtime plumbing. we need to decide whether to stream raw tokens for args or reconstructed arg blobs. also consider escapes for partial JSON.

jin_sales: fincorp is negotiating a dedicated capacity contract. they flagged this as a blocker for go-live in 6w if we can deliver.

ravi_sre: perf callout — streaming extra event types increases IOPS/serialization overhead. we should perf-test at sustained 50 rps, avg seq len ~512, to verify p99 stays within SLO.

Aisha_pm: proposed scope options:
- Minimal: new event types (tool_call_chunk, tool_call_end) that emit reconstructed args only at end. no schema validation server-side.
- Medium: emit incremental argument blobs (tool_call_chunk updates) + final structured_output event. SDK surfaces chunks.
- Full: also add server-side structured schema validation, validation failure hook, and automatic fallback to non-streaming enriched response.

marta_eng: rough eng tasks: runtime event framing change, kernel-friendly flush points, SDK streaming changes (js/python), QA harness + canary. estimates: minimal 2w, medium 4-5w, full 8-10w.

Aisha_pm: acceptance criteria for Medium (target):
- streaming includes event types: tool_call_start, tool_call_chunk, tool_call_end, structured_output_end
- backward-compatible: older clients ignore unknown event types
- SDKs expose chunk stream to user callbacks with ordering guarantees
- perf gate: p99 latency <= baseline + 250ms at 50 rps
- canary: 2 pilot customers for 1 week with no regressions

marta_eng: example event frames (proto snippets):
```json
{"type":"tool_call_start","tool":"http_fetch","call_id":"abc123"}
{"type":"tool_call_chunk","call_id":"abc123","chunk":"{\"url\":\"https:/"}
{"type":"tool_call_end","call_id":"abc123","complete":true}
{"type":"structured_output_end","schema_id":"v1","payload":"{\"results\":[...]}","checksum":"sha256:..."}
```

jin_sales: need comms + docs + sample prompts. i'll get fincorp to pilot and provide example prompts and evaluation criteria.

sam_support: support request: add a per-customer flag so we can enable verbose streaming event logs for pilot customers and collect debug traces without impacting global infra.

ops-bot: created PROJ-392 in product backlog and linked to ticket ZD-12345

Aisha_pm: next steps: i'll draft a short PRD today and post in #product by EOD. marta, please add an engineering estimate and high-level design by Thu. jin, collect pilot sign-off. sam, assemble support test cases and sample prompts.

marta_eng: +1 i'll drop a 1-pager with dataflow diagram, failure modes, and edge cases (partial json, invalid utf8 in chunks).

sam_support: thanks all — i'll update fincorp and sync on the runbook next week. :thumbsup:
